answer: In an agent economy, resist sybils by forcing each identity to grow a unique sequential orchard of attested contributions that cannot be parallelized: each new leaf requires a memory-hard proof chained to the prior one. A public lantern of peer-attested timestamps reveals when multiple identities share identical orchard roots, proving clones. Only after the orchard depth allows a lotus of reputation to bloom does the identity gain full voting weight, imposing super-linear cost on attackers who must sustain distinct orchards.
